sam-customer: Hey team — after the v10.2 model bump our KB answers tuned by the assistant are coming back much shorter and they skip step-by-step guidance. Happened around 2026-02-25T14:12:03Z. Request id: req_0a1b2c. Anyone seen this?

maria-support: Sorry about that, @sam-customer — we'll look into it. Can you paste a minimal prompt plus the two outputs (before/after) inline and confirm which model string you hit? Also include the full request id and approximate timestamp.

sam-customer: Prompt we use: "How do I safely rotate a user's API key without downtime?"
Expected (pre-v10.2): "Start by creating a new key, update services, verify traffic, revoke old key, monitor. Details: sample script + retries + TTL guidance..."
Actual (post-v10.2): "Create new key, update services, revoke old key." — noticeably shorter, no scripts or verification steps.

maria-support: Thanks — tagging @lena-ml and @eli-engineer for triage. Could you run the reproduce curl below so we capture headers and the exact response object (we need the full JSON response):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-rlfs-v10.2-default","input":"How do I safely rotate a user's API key without downtime?","max_tokens":450,"temperature":0.0,"log_request_id":true}'
```

lena-ml: Quick note: we did a small canary tweak to tighten default system instructions for a set of knowledge-base flows to reduce verbosity in some contexts. That might explain it. I'll fetch the exact change diff. @eli-engineer any infra or routing changes that could alter sampling params?

eli-engineer: No infra routing changes. Sampling params are passed through the handler unchanged. If the system prompt changed, that would do it. Please attach the raw response JSON payloads (full object with meta headers). We'll diff the model metadata and the sampling flags.

sam-customer: Pasting raw responses (trimmed to essentials):
- pre-v10.2 (request_id: req_old_9f): {"request_id":"req_old_9f","model":"redwood-rlfs-v10.1","completion":{"text":"Start by creating a new key... [long markdown with script]","tokens":236}}
- post-v10.2 (request_id: req_0a1b2c): {"request_id":"req_0a1b2c","model":"redwood-rlfs-v10.2-default","completion":{"text":"Create new key, update services, revoke old key.","tokens":42}}

maria-support: Perfect, that's exactly what we needed. Escalating this as a regression (SEV-3) to ML team for behavior regression analysis. Case assigned: INC-2026-987. I'll coordinate follow-up and let you know the ETA. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 10.2 -> 10.3 scheduled for 2026-02-26T03:00:00Z

eli-engineer: I'll diff the system prompt and rollout history and check whether the canary applied a narrower ending policy or adjusted the default max_tokens for the KB persona. Expect update by EOD.

lena-ml: Found the change: a short system instruction was added to reduce "verbose procedural steps" for KB flows in v10.2 canary. We can revert or make it opt-in per customer. @maria-support any SLA timeline needed?

maria-support: We're informing the customer that we can revert the change for their tenancy or push a config toggle within 24 hours. Sam, would you prefer immediate revert or a config toggle to restore previous verbosity?

sam-customer: Immediate revert for now please — the missing troubleshooting steps break our automated docs ingestion. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

maria-support: Revert requested and tracked under INC-2026-987. Will update when action is complete. :raised_hands:
